carousels.hook: Free AI tools train on your pasted data
carousels.throughline: Free AI tools train on everything you paste, and one setting can stop it.

reel_beats.hook: Free AI tools train on every paste—including customer data

body.text: Free AI tools like ChatGPT train on everything you paste into them.
They keep your data to improve their models, not just answer your question.
Turn off ‘data sharing’ in settings to stop them from learning your inputs.
Paid plans usually don’t train on your data by default—use them for sensitive info.
